# Executive Summary 

## Data Cleaning

```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(zoo)
library(stringr)
library(gt)

i_res_headers <- read_csv("/Users/jdumanski24/Desktop/CDSC/Levine/CSV/res_survey.csv", n_max = 2, col_names = FALSE, show_col_types = FALSE)

questions <- as.character(i_res_headers[1,])

answer_choices <- as.character(i_res_headers[2,])

questions_filled <- na.locf(ifelse(questions == "" | is.na(questions), NA, questions))

clean_headers <- paste(questions_filled, answer_choices, sep = "_")

i_res_raw <- read_csv("/Users/jdumanski24/Desktop/CDSC/Levine/CSV/res_survey.csv", skip = 2, col_names = clean_headers, show_col_types = FALSE)
i_res <- i_res_raw %>%
  select(c(10:ncol(i_res_raw)))

i_res <- i_res %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ na_if(as.character(.), "")
    )
  )
i_res <- i_res %>%
  select(!"Which departments are primarily responsible for management of the following procedures in cleft care at your institution?_Other (please specify)")
i_res_q <- i_res %>%
  mutate(Q1 = do.call(coalesce, pick(1:2))) %>%
  mutate(Q2 = do.call(coalesce, pick(3:5))) %>%
  mutate(Q3 = do.call(coalesce, pick(6:9))) %>%

  mutate(Q7b = do.call(coalesce, pick(22:24))) %>%
  mutate(Q7c = do.call(coalesce, pick(25:27))) %>%
```

## Residents Analysis

```{r, echo = FALSE}
# 2 with 7 and 8
# 2 with 11
# 2 with 11 and 12
question1s <- c("Q7a", "Q7b", "Q7c", "Q7d", "Q8a", "Q8b", "Q8c", "Q8d", "Q11", "Q12")

question2s <- c(rep("Q2", 10))

question_dic_res <- data.frame(question1s, question2s)
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
validation <- function(question1, question2, data){
  df <- data %>%
    transmute(
      response1 = .data[[question1]],
      response2 = .data[[question2]]
    ) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  comparison_res <- df %>%
    group_by(response1, response2) %>%
    summarize(counts = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(response2) %>%
    mutate(percent = counts / sum(counts) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  table_comparison <- table(df$response2, df$response1)
  #table_hours
  test <- suppressWarnings(chisq.test(table_comparison))
  
  if (mean(test$expected <= 5) < 0.8 | any(test$expected < 1)){
    fish_test <- fisher.test(table_comparison, simulate.p.value = TRUE)
    if (fish_test$p.value <= 0.05){
      significant <- TRUE
    }
    else {
      significant <- FALSE
    }
    return(c("question1", "question2", round(fish_test$p.value, digits = 4), significant, "fisher"))
  }
  else{
    if (test$p.value <= 0.05){
      significant <- TRUE
    }
    else {
      significant <- FALSE
    }
  }
  return(c("question1", "question2", round(test$p.value, digits = 4), significant, "chisq"))
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
res_results <- data.frame(
  Question1 = character(),
  Question2 = character(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  Significant = logical(), 
  Test = character()
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(question_dic_res))) {

  res_results[i, ] <- validation(
    question1 = question_dic_res$question1s[i],
    question2 = question_dic_res$question2s[i],
    data = i_res_coalesced
  )
}

res_results <- res_results %>%
  mutate(
    Adj_P = round(p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), digits = 4),
    Sig_Adj = Adj_P <= 0.05,
    Question1 = question_dic_res$question1s, 
    Question2 = question_dic_res$question2s
  ) %>% 
  arrange(Adj_P)

gt(res_results)
```

### Question 2 with Questions 11 and 12

```{r, echo = FALSE}
library(modelsummary)
cleft_program <- i_res_coalesced %>%
  filter(Q2 != "Unsure") %>%
  mutate(cleft_response = as.factor(Q11), 
         program = as.factor(Q12), 
         cleft_center = as.factor(Q2)) %>%
  select(cleft_response, cleft_center, program) %>% 
  drop_na()
cleft_glm <- glm(cleft_response ~ cleft_center + program, family = "binomial", data = cleft_program)
cleft_null <- glm(cleft_response ~ 1, family = "binomial", data = cleft_program)
anova(cleft_glm, cleft_null)

#logistic regression 
#use model summary
# we notice signficance when comparing the model with program and cleft centers to the null model when predicting if residents are interested in continuing cleft care after residency 
```

### The logistic regression summary

```{r, echo = FALSE}
modelsummary(cleft_glm)
```

# Residents & Directors Cross-Referenced

```{r, echo = FALSE}
common_qs_res <- c("Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q6", "Q7a", "Q7b", "Q7c", "Q7d","Q8a","Q8b", "Q8c", "Q8d", "Q5", "Q9", "Q10a", "Q10b", "Q10c", "Q10d", "Q10e", "Q12", "Q13", "Q14", "Q15",
                   "role")
common_qs_dir <- c("Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Q9", "Q10a", "Q10b", "Q10c", "Q10d", "Q11a","Q11b","Q11c", "Q11d", "Q12", "Q13", "Q16a", "Q16b", "Q16c", "Q16d", "Q16e", "Q18", "Q19", "Q20",
                 "Q21_new",   "role")
q_dic <- data.frame(common_qs_res, common_qs_dir)

res_common <- i_res_coalesced %>%
  select(all_of(common_qs_res))

dir_common <- i_dir_coalesced %>%
  select(all_of(common_qs_dir)) %>%
  setNames(common_qs_res)
res_dir <- bind_rows(
  res_common,
  dir_common
)
```

# Run the tests

```{r, echo = FALSE}
res_dir_results <- data.frame(
  Question1 = character(),
  Question2 = character(),
  P_value = numeric(),
  Significant = logical(), 
  Test = character()
)

for (i in seq_len(ncol(res_dir)-1)) {

  res_dir_results[i, ] <- validation(
    question1 = colnames(res_dir)[i],
    question2 = colnames(res_dir)[ncol(res_dir)],
    data = res_dir
  )
}

res_dir_results <- res_dir_results %>%
  mutate(
    Adj_P = round(p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH"), digits = 4),
    Sig_Adj = Adj_P <= 0.05,
    Question1 = colnames(res_dir)[1:(ncol(res_dir) -1)], 
    Question2 = "role"
  ) %>% arrange(Adj_P)
gt(res_dir_results)
```

# Visualization

```{r, echo = FALSE}
stack_bar <- function(q_reference, q_group, data){
  bar_df <- data %>%
    group_by(.data[[q_reference]], .data[[q_group]]) %>%
    summarize(counts = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    group_by(.data[[q_group]]) %>%
    mutate(percent = counts / sum(counts) * 100) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  p <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = .data[[q_reference]], y = percent, fill = .data[[q_reference]])) +
    geom_col() +
    facet_wrap(vars(.data[[q_group]])) +
    labs(
      title = paste(q_reference, "vs", q_group, sep = " "),
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of responses"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank()
    )
  return(p)
}
```

```{r, echo = FALSE}
plots_res <- pmap(question_dic_res, 
                  function(question1s, question2s){
                    stack_bar(
                      q_reference = question1s, 
                      q_group = question2s,
                      data = i_res_coalesced
                    )
                  })
walk(plots_res, print)

question_dic_res_dir <- data.frame(question1s_res_dir = colnames(res_dir)
                                   , question2s_res_dir = rep("role", ncol(res_dir)))

question_dic_res_dir <- question_dic_res_dir %>%
  filter(question1s_res_dir != "role") 
plots_comp <- pmap(question_dic_res_dir, 
                   function(question1s_res_dir, question2s_res_dir){
                     stack_bar(
                       q_reference = question1s_res_dir, 
                       q_group = question2s_res_dir,
                       data = res_dir
                     )
                   })
walk(plots_comp, print)
```
